Description

Ser Ignasse serves in King Thordan's Knights of the Round. This sheet uses the shared knight traits and Ser Ignasse's individual statistics, equipment and abilities.

Defense

AC 34, touch 19, flat-footed 25 (+8 dex, +1 dodge, +9 armor, +6 natural)

Hp 434 [560] (28d10+280)

Fort +26, Ref +25, Will +14

Offense

Speed 30 ft

Melee +2 Lance +42/+37/+32 (1d8+14/19-20 x3)

Statistics

Str 34, Dex 28, Con 30, Int 14, Wis 16, Cha 14

Base Atk +28; CMB +40; CMD 59

SQ Outsider Traits, Does not Breathe, Does not Eat, Does not Sleep

Gear +1 Tatami-do, +2 Lance (Earthen Burst)

description.value: The Outsider racial HD and native defense fields carry the traits of this creature type; see the individual subtypes and exceptions.
Ser Ignasse (Knights of the Round) does not breathe.
Ser Ignasse (Knights of the Round) does not eat.
Ser Ignasse (Knights of the Round) does not sleep.

Ser Ignasse learns to be more maneuverable while wearing armor. Whenever he is wearing armor, he reduces the armor check penalty by 5 (to a minimum of 0) and increases the maximum Dexterity bonus allowed by his armor by 5. In addition, he can move at his normal speed while wearing heavy armor.

Once every 1d4+1 rounds as a standard action, Ser Ignasse smacks downward into the ground releasing a 45-ft.-cone of earthen glaives from his lance. All foes in the area of effect take damage equal to triple Ser Ignasse's lance damage in earth damage and are immobilized for 1d4+1 rounds unless they make a successful Fortitude save (DC 34) for half damage and negating the immobilized effect.

description.value: Once every 1d3+1 rounds as a standard action, Ser Ignasse can cause the ground to erupt wildly around it within a 60-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect take 15d10 points of earth damage and are inflicted with the weighted status effect. They must make a successful Reflex save (DC 27) to reduce the damage by half and negate the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as an 8th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 31).

description.unidentified: Worn by samurai as a lighter-weight alternative to o-yoroi, tatami-do is a full-body field armor that combines both metal lamellar and kikko components into a suit of mail with a cloth backing. It typically includes a collapsible kabuto helmet or an armored hood, as well as arm, shoulder, and thigh guards.
A lance deals double damage when used from the back of a charging mount. While mounted, you can wield a lance with one hand.
